How to read the plots and interpret the comparison

Each dot is a saved selection evaluated by classifier LOOCV, not a participant. Repeated selections of the same panel remain visible with horizontal jitter; they are not independent cohorts. The dark diamond shows the mean; whiskers show ±1 standard deviation over selections.

GAS objectives remain those selected by the original mean LDA/SVM balanced accuracy over 20 seeds. New classifiers do not trigger objective reselection. These plots evaluate transfer to other classifiers, not optimized performance for each model.

Bias Field is not plotted: there are no verified new-classifier results for it. Some neural-network fits raised convergence warnings (see the results report). Higher balanced accuracy means better average ASD/TD recognition, not a validated autism diagnosis.
